commit: not published — FATHOM_REFERENCE_COMMIT was not set

payloads.name: nvme-smart-log-page.bin
payloads.note: NVMe SMART / Health Information log page 0x02, 512 bytes, exactly as the controller returned it. Log page 0x02 is counters; the controller serial number lives in Identify Controller, which FATHOM never reads.
payloads.reason: macOS denied or failed the read-only NVMe SMART user client (IOReturn -536870201)

payloads.name: smc-key-inventory.json
payloads.note: Every four-character key AppleSMC enumerated on this Mac, in the order it enumerated them.

payloads.name: smc-key-values.json
payloads.note: 2611 keys read, 405 with bytes withheld, 139 refused by AppleSMC. A refused key is kept with its IOReturn rather than dropped: gate 2 asks what this Mac will not publish, and a shorter list with no explanation answers a different question.

payloads.name: ioreport-channel-inventory.plist
payloads.note: The binary property list the C bridge builds from libIOReport's channel enumeration. It is raw down to the bridge's own flattening (Sources/CFathomHardware/FathomHardware.c), not down to libIOReport's dictionaries — a fixture of it tests the Swift decoder against real values and says nothing about the flattening.

payloads.name: ioreport-subscribed-channels.plist
payloads.note: The channel set IOReportCreateSubscription actually granted this process, which is what records the channels this Mac agreed to publish. Requested groups: Energy Model, CPU Stats, GPU Stats, AMC Stats, NVMe.

payloads.name: ioreport-delta-sample.plist
payloads.note: A delta over 1.015 seconds. The interval travels with the payload in this manifest because IOReportSampler.watts() divides by it — a delta fixture without its interval cannot be replayed, only guessed at.

payloads.name: iohid-temperature-sensors.plist
payloads.note: IOHIDEventSystem temperature events (usage page 0xff00, usage 5, event type 15), serialized by the C bridge.

smcByteHandling: bytes recorded only for the types fathom_smc_decode_numeric reads; every other key keeps its name, type and size and withholds its bytes
